tools.name: inburgering_help
tools.description: For anyone who has to do inburgering (Dutch civic integration) and doesn't know how it works. Without a question: a start-here overview (route, exams, booking, exam day, results). With a question (booking, DigiD, exam day rules, what each exam part looks like, KNM, results and waiting times, A2 vs B

tools.name: which_exam
tools.description: Explains which inburgering exams belong to a situation the user chose themselves from the official list (their DUO or municipality letter is the authority). Without an id: the list. With an id: the exams, who runs them, why, and official sources. It works from the situation the user picks and needs

tools.name: practice
tools.description: KNM (Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij) practice questions in Dutch, like the real exam. action 'next' returns a question with lettered choices (optionally by theme), without the answer. action 'answer' with question_id and the user's letter returns whether it is right, with an explanation. Eac

tools.name: knm_facts
tools.description: Checked facts for the KNM exam: which organization to contact in which situation (gemeente, DUO, UWV, SVB, Belastingdienst, ...) and what it does. Without a topic: the fact groups. With a topic like 'healthcare' or 'moving house': the matching facts.

tools.name: explain_grammar
tools.description: Short Dutch grammar lessons at A2 level with examples and a memory tip: de/het, plurals, word order, questions, negation, modal and separable verbs, past tense, linking words, comparatives. Without a topic: the list.
